nq_btc_follow.rule: During New-York cash hours (09:30-16:00 NY, Mon-Fri): if the last closed 1-minute bar of US100 moved by >= 6 sigma (sigma = RMS of US100 1-minute log returns over the M1 bars of the previous 20 calendar days), enter BTCUSD at market at the next minute in the direction of the move; stop = 2 * sigma_btc(1 min, same window) * sqrt(60) from the fill; time exit 60 minutes after entry; one position at a time.
known_weaknesses: the edge is a 2020-2021 phenomenon (2018 and 2019 slightly negative): 3/5 years positive is the minimum allowed
with us500 as the leader instead of us100 the same rule gives PF 1.145 (t 1.46); with k=2 PF 1.123 (t 1.23)
38% of the trades are entered 09:30-10:00 NY where the expectancy is weak (+0.02 R); not tuned away

Dukascopy's own BTC spread was 120-190 bp in 2018-2020 and 18 bp in 2021: the in-sample edge was not capturable on Dukascopy then; the forward-looking FP cost model (2.2 bp) assumes the same mid dynamics on FP's quote
entry delayed by 1 / 2 / 5 minutes: PF 1.35 / 1.30 / 1.34 (degrades smoothly, does not collapse)
